programme.title: Special Delivery

programme.title: Danish Poet, The

programme.title: How They Saw Us Proudly She Marches
programme.desc: A recruitment film made in 1943. Its words offer women the excitement and challenge of new kinds of work in the armed services. The visual message, however, suggests that this work is merely temporary and possibly even unnatural for women.

programme.title: Beautiful Lennard Island

programme.title: Challenger An Industrial Romance

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu
programme.desc: Les sauveteurs passent un week-end à San Diego. Matt et Summer se sentent hantés par une étrange présence. CJ se prend d’affection pour un dauphin orphelin dans un parc aquatique. Mitch se retrouve naufragé avec son frère lorsque leur bateau se retourne.

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives

programme.title: Doctor Who : Saison 2

programme.title: Doctor Who : Saison 2

programme.desc: Made in 1957, this film glamorizes a service job in which minor emergencies appear as serious and absorbing challenges. Marriage is assumed to be the natural end of the middle-class woman's working life.

programme.title: Mountain Of Sgaana
programme.desc: This film spins a magical tale of a young man who is stolen away to the spirit world, and the young woman who rescues him. Haida filmmaker Christopher Auchter’s dream-like gem brilliantly entwines traditional animation with formal elements of Haida art.

programme.title: Churchills Island
programme.desc: A classic presentation of the strategy of the Battle of Britain, the film shows, with penetrating clarity, the relationship of the various forces that went to make up the island's defenses. The first NFB film to win an Oscar.

programme.title: Safe Distance, A
programme.desc: A Safe Distance examines the services needed by and available to battered women. The film looks at some innovative approaches to providing services and accommodation for battered women in rural, northern, and Native communities.

programme.title: A Love Affair With Politics A Portrait Of Marion Dewar
programme.desc: This spirited documentary on one of Canada's most successful female politicians was filmed while she was mayor of Ottawa. Dewar talks of her political career as a natural extension of her roles of wife, mother, public-health nurse and ordinary citizen.

programme.title: Moving On
programme.desc: Moving On examines the services needed by and available to battered women. This film looks at the problem of wife assault in London, Ontario, a rare model community that has effectively responded to the issue.
